verdict: The script is a benign currency‑formatting widget that fetches exchange rates from a first‑party API and updates DOM text nodes.
summary: It retrieves JSON rates from https://api.shopkit.dev, caches them for 5 minutes, and rewrites elements with data-price attributes using Intl.NumberFormat. No cookies, tracking, or third‑party code are observed.

text: Fetches exchange‑rate JSON from a remote API and caches it for 5 minutes.
Selects all elements with a [data-price] attribute, converts the amount to the page currency, and writes the formatted string to textContent.

title: Outbound fetch to first‑party API
impact: Retrieves public exchange‑rate data; no personal or payment data is transmitted.
recommendation: Ensure the endpoint uses TLS and returns only expected rate data; monitor for unexpected response changes.

pci: PCI DSS 6.4.3 / 11.6.1 assessment: No cardholder data is collected, stored, or transmitted; the script does not interfere with payment‑page integrity, so it is acceptable on a PCI‑scope page.
privacy: GDPR/CCPA assessment: The script processes no personal data and performs no tracking; therefore it does not require user consent under GDPR/CCPA.

text: The widget appears benign; it can remain enabled but should be monitored for any future changes to the fetched endpoint or added functionality.

policy: script-src 'self' https://cdn.example.com; connect-src https://api.shopkit.dev; img-src 'none'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline';
notes: Only the API domain is needed for outbound fetch; no other external resources are required.

note: Endpoint used to retrieve exchange‑rate data.
